description: CSV drift. Two CSV documents in, URL-encoded as the base and candidate query parameters (each up to 12,000 bytes), a drift report out: row count drift, column drift (added, removed, reordered), per-column type drift and missing-value share drift on shared columns, every finding disclosed, verdict on the drift / no-drift / incompatible ladder. Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

base.description: The baseline CSV document (up to 12,000 bytes).

candidate.description: The candidate CSV document compared against the baseline (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: csv-drift
